messages:
Elaine: Quick debrief from today's DR dry-run — notes and action items below. TL;DR: multi-region routing flapped for ~3m during the failover test due to BGP route propagation timing + Envoy config mismatch. Backups validated but the restore runbook needs clearer pre-checks and an isolated dry-run section. Please ack owners and add any items. @Raj @Marco @Taylor

Raj: Saw the spike in BGP flaps. I can reproduce on staging by shortening BGP soft-reconfig timers — automation that pushes routes currently assumes <1s convergence, which isn't safe. Investigating automation and route propagation gating.

Marco: Envoy config drift was the main reason traffic didn't failover cleanly — the regional weight rule didn't bind because the healthcheck label was missing on one pool. I'll add explicit fallback routing and a config CI check.

Taylor: Product telemetry shows ~0.6% customer-facing error rate during the window (14:12–14:16 UTC). Not huge, but noticeable. We should update the SLO doc and communicate to impacted teams.

ops-bot: DR-dryrun-2026-03-24: completed; incident window 14:12-14:16 UTC; auto-created follow-up ticket INF-492.

Elaine: Summarizing concrete action items (short list). Please confirm ownership and due dates in-thread. I added tentative dates — adjust if needed.

1) Routing: add explicit fallback + health-check gating to route updates (prevent route flip until all regions report healthy). Owner: Raj. Due: 2026-04-05. Ticket: INF-493.

2) Envoy config validation: enforce schema/label checks in CI and add a regression test that simulates weight application across regions. Owner: Marco. Due: 2026-04-01. PR reference: draft PR #756.

3) Backups & Restore runbook: expand pre-check checklist (S3 listing, checksum verify, isolated test restore steps, permission checks) and add an explicit "do-not-run-in-prod" dry-run path. Owner: Taylor. Due: 2026-03-31.

4) Game-day cadence & invites: schedule next dry-run with internal customers + oncall runbook drill on 2026-04-09. Owner: Elaine. Confirm invites by 2026-03-28.

5) Postmortem brief: short one-pager capturing root cause, detection timeline, and knobs adjusted. Owner: Elaine. Due: 2026-03-29. Attach to INF-492.

Pre-check snippets to include in the runbook (put under a "preflight" section):

```
# list latest backups
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-backups/prod/ | tail -n 5
# verify checksum of candidate backup
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/prod/2026-03-24.sql.gz - | sha256sum
# quick restore into isolated env (test-only)
rdb restore --from s3://redwood-backups/prod/2026-03-24 --to cluster=dr-dryrun --verify
# quick check for routing endpoints
kubectl -n routing get endpoints honeycomb -o jsonpath='{.subsets[*].addresses[*].ip}'
```

Also add these small operational checks to the runbook: `ip route get 10.0.0.1` and `kubectl -n routing describe svc honeycomb` — both should be part of a 2-min smoke checklist before cutover.

Raj: ack, starting on the routing automation change today. I'll schedule a 30m triage for Tue (2026-03-30) to review changes and test plan. :hammer_and_wrench:

Marco: ack, will push CI schema checks and the regression test. I'll link the PR in INF-493 when ready. :white_check_mark:

Taylor: ack, will draft the enhanced restore runbook and attach a step-by-step dry-run checklist. Will ping #docs with the draft for review by 2026-03-29. :page_facing_up:

Elaine: Thanks all. I'll update INF-492 with owners/dates above and post a short recap for leadership. If anyone adds more items, drop them here and ops-bot will append to the ticket.

Raj: quick note — we should add a metric to track route convergence time (histogram) so future regressions are visible in Grafana. Adding to INF-493.

Marco: also will add a tiny sanity check in the deploy job: fail the deploy if `envoy-config` doesn't contain the healthcheck label for any regional pool.

Taylor: adding a sentence in runbook that the test restore must be done in an isolated namespace with fake credentials, not prod keys.

Elaine: Great. Closing thread for now — follow-ups will live in INF-492/INF-493. See you in the triage sync. :thumbsup:
